statements.proposition: The change introduces zero breaking changes to existing functionality.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: The default OpenRouter model mapping, which applies when no new env vars are set, is changed in the diff: sonnet 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4' -> 'anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet' and opus 'anthropic/claude-opus-4' -> 'anthropic/claude-3-opus' (haiku unchanged). Existing deployments therefore get different upstream models after the change. Also wrangler.toml's custom_domain route was changed from cc.yovy.app to cc.xiaohui.cool. Whether 'different model' counts as 'breaking' is a reading of the word, hence MEDIUM, but it contradicts the stated 'zero breaking changes' and 'default behavior unchanged'.
evidence: formatRequest.ts patch: removed mapModel returning 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4' and 'anthropic/claude-opus-4' for sonnet/opus
wrangler.toml patch: routes pattern cc.yovy.app -> cc.xiaohui.cool
Not run: no tests exist in the change list; judged from the diff
